headline: Pele's jersey sold for 60 crore BDT
summary: A legendary football icon's kit has fetched a record-breaking price at auction.
details: A jersey worn by the legendary Brazilian football star Pele has been sold for 60 crore BDT.
The item, a piece of sporting history, was put up for auction and attracted significant interest from collectors worldwide.
Pele is widely regarded as one of the greatest players of all time, making his memorabilia highly coveted by sports enthusiasts.

headline: Protests erupt in Tongi: Highway blocked to demand justice after child rape
summary: Angry residents block the Dhaka-Mymensingh highway in Tongi, demanding the death penalty for the perpetrator of a child rape case.
details: Protesters have blocked the Dhaka-Mymensingh highway in Tongi to demand immediate justice for a child rape victim.
The demonstration was sparked by the rape of a young girl, leading to widespread public outrage in the local community.
Protesters, including women and children, gathered on the highway with placards demanding the death penalty for the accused.
The blockade caused significant traffic congestion on the main highway, affecting thousands of commuters.
Local authorities are working to resolve the situation and ensure the legal process proceeds against the perpetrator.
caption:
A child rape case in Tongi has led to massive protests and the blockade of the Dhaka-Mymensingh highway.
